scope: Instantaneous homogeneous Fourier-patch energy screen for the broad-shear seed along two saved mean-state replays. Mass whitening, diffusion, strain, and sampled divergence correction are reported. No perturbation wave time integration, nonlinear transfer, total energy, moment/cone closure, or Navier-Stokes acceptance is claimed.

broad_shear_seed_reference.note: The energy screen reports 2 lambda as the amplitude-squared rate; broad_shear_growth records both lambda and 2 lambda.

constrained_reference.note: Reuses the saved constrained state and tangent; this energy screen does not re-solve or certify the wave.

quadrature_note.weighting: normalized cylindrical r weight on the fixed physical patch
quadrature_note.note: The fixed-patch screen records the missing 0.62 meridional cutoff explicitly; endpoint rates are not asserted as cutoff-converged production estimates.
